title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (scope enforcement)
description: patch_file on .moeb/skills/run.skill.md was rejected by scope enforcement ('exists on disk but has not been read') because the file had been written but not read via read_file. The operation was subsequently recovered via write_file.
proposed_resolution: Before calling patch_file on a newly written file, call read_file on that path to register it in the read scope. The scope enforcement check gates on reads, not writes.

title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (hunk mismatch)
description: A second patch_file attempt on .moeb/skills/run.skill.md failed with 'error applying hunk #1' due to context lines not matching the file content. The operation was recovered via write_file with the complete corrected content.
proposed_resolution: After reading a file, regenerate diffs from the read content rather than from the pre-write memory of what was written. Alternatively, use write_file instead of patch_file when the full file has already been read.

title: Project override skill files structurally exceed context-budget
description: The project override mechanism at .moeb/skills/ requires copying the entire bundled skill file (~200-270 lines) plus the required additions (~65 lines), inevitably exceeding the 300-line context-budget. Both run.skill.md (~369 lines) and spec.skill.md (~400 lines) exceeded the budget, causing context-budget to fail and reducing rubric_score. This structural conflict is not resolvable within a single run without violating verbatim-identical or minimum-diff constraints.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a partial skill section override mechanism that allows .moeb/skills/ files to declare named section replacements rather than full-file replacements, keeping each override file to only the new/changed sections and staying within the 300-line budget.
